scripts.check: pnpm check:shared && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:backend && pnpm check:mobile

scripts.check:backend: pnpm --dir apps/backend typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/backend lint:check && pnpm --dir apps/backend exec jest --config test/jest.json --coverage=false --runInBand --passWithNoTests --forceExit
